description: The exact F32 row tile change (wide-verify-f32-rows.json) on the merged wide verify branch: with the wide_verify candidate option, Flash TP4 verify steps of 65 to 192 rows run the vocabulary head, the MoE router and the compressor projections in the whole-K row tiles of f32.rows.verify instead of the ordered split route. The locked f32_verify_rows_deepseek41_sm120 module loads exactly where the dense wide fold module does, once per rank, and resolves its nine entries with the configure values of its three computes. The operation edits are regenerated from captures of the merge's first parent and of the merge. Without the option every journal, create range and history is identical.
